name: vuh2640_thorn_legA_sitout
description: VUH-2640 Leg A live check (single-PC loopback), derived offline from net_twilight_thorn_bots05 by tools/scenario/safe_field_recovery/make_thorn_legA.py; run through that directory's run.py thin entry. The Calling route is bots05's. In the Calling, after its pilots, the original Friend1 runtime is paused 4200 ms (bounded experiment, pause.py budget) so its lifetime expires before Thorn. Only the host continues: the host attests a boss sit-out at 2/34/157, the fenced friend lands in the arena sitting out (outage), the host clears Thorn alone, and the friend gets no 4/16, 315 or restored control. KH2COOP_RESYNC_CATALOG_TRACE=1 records the first post-Thorn field's catalog for VUH-2674. Leg B is expected NOT to complete yet (no reviewed post-Thorn row): the friend is expected to stay sitting out.
qualificationGaps: Needs VUH-2640 Leg A (protocol 35) and the VUH-2674 catalog trace on the tested products.
The 4200 ms pause is a bounded experiment, not a lease-before-relay guarantee (pre-pause relay age is assumed).
Pre-ready native safety (between the arena load and DownedSpike's first ready frame) is shown only by footage and the friend's outage/hold rows.
A host clearing Thorn alone is untested; a host death with the friend sitting out is everyone down (Continue).
Leg B after Thorn needs VUH-2674's reviewed row; the friend staying in the arena sitting out is the expected first-slice result.
The atk_thorn attach on the sitting-out friend is traced ([downed] outage held-player-moved), not prevented.
